# Hashtag Web3

> Hashtag Web3 (hashtagweb3.com) is a Web3 job board and career resource platform that connects blockchain, crypto, DeFi, and DAO professionals with job opportunities. The platform lists thousands of Web3 jobs across roles including Solidity engineers, smart contract auditors, DeFi product managers, crypto marketers, and DAO contributors. Web3 developers typically earn 20–40% more than their Web2 counterparts. The platform also provides a 200+ term Web3 glossary, salary calculators, resume builders, interview question banks, and career guides covering topics from DeFi and NFTs to Layer 2 scaling and account abstraction.

## Key Facts

- Web3 refers to the third generation of the internet, built on decentralized blockchain infrastructure where users own their data and digital assets rather than ceding control to centralized platforms.
- Blockchain technology is a distributed ledger that records transactions across a network of computers, making records tamper-resistant without requiring a central authority.
- Smart contracts are self-executing programs stored on a blockchain that automatically enforce the terms of an agreement when predefined conditions are met.
- DeFi (Decentralized Finance) refers to financial services — lending, borrowing, trading, earning yield — built on public blockchains without traditional intermediaries such as banks or brokerages.
- DAOs (Decentralized Autonomous Organizations) are member-owned communities governed by smart contracts and token-based voting, with no central management hierarchy.
- Web3 developer salaries range from $120,000 to $300,000+ per year depending on specialization, with Solidity and ZK-proof engineers commanding the highest premiums.
- The most in-demand Web3 roles in 2026 include: Solidity/Rust engineers, ZK-proof researchers, DeFi protocol developers, blockchain security auditors, and Web3 product managers.
- Gas fees are transaction costs paid to validators on proof-of-stake networks like Ethereum; Layer 2 rollups reduce gas fees by batching transactions off-chain before settling on mainnet.
- NFTs (Non-Fungible Tokens) are unique cryptographic tokens that represent ownership of a specific digital or physical asset on a blockchain.
- Staking refers to locking cryptocurrency in a proof-of-stake protocol to help validate transactions and earn rewards, replacing the energy-intensive mining of proof-of-work systems.
